Assumptions:
This packing list assumes a standard business casual to business formal dress code. It is optimized for a carry-on suitcase and provides gender-neutral suggestions where possible, with specific options noted. The focus is on layering to adapt to the variable weather conditions.

Trip & Weather Overview:
- Destination: London, UK
- Dates: 2024-10-15 to 2024-10-17
- Forecast: Cool, wet, and windy. Temperatures range from 10°C to 14°C with heavy rain and strong winds on the first two days.

Packing Checklist

(Outerwear)
A versatile, weather-resistant outer layer is critical for this trip.
- [ ] Waterproof Trench Coat or Smart Rain Jacket (x1): Choose a neutral color like black, navy, or beige that works with business attire.
- [ ] Compact Travel Umbrella (x1): Essential for the heavy rain forecasted.
- [ ] Wool Scarf (x1): Provides warmth against the wind and adds a professional touch.

(Footwear)
Comfort and water resistance are key. You will likely be walking between transport and meetings.
- [ ] Waterproof Leather Shoes or Boots (x1 pair): Such as leather Chelsea boots, brogues, or loafers treated with a waterproofing spray. Avoid suede.
- [ ] Smart Dress Shoes (x1 pair): A second, comfortable pair for indoor meetings or dinners.

(Business Attire)
Focus on layering and fabrics like merino wool, cashmere, and cotton blends that provide warmth without bulk.
- [ ] Suit or Blazer/Trousers/Skirt Combo (x2): Choose versatile pieces in navy, grey, or black that can be mixed and matched.
- [ ] Dress Shirts or Blouses (x3): One for each day.
- [ ] Fine-Knit Sweater or Cardigan (x2): For layering under a blazer on colder days (Oct 15/16). Merino wool is an excellent choice.
- [ ] Business-appropriate Trousers or Skirt (x1, extra): A separate item to mix with blazers.
- [ ] Belt (x1)

(Casual & Basics)
For travel, evenings, or any downtime.
- [ ] Dark Jeans or Chinos (x1 pair)
- [ ] Casual Shirt or Sweater (x1)
- [ ] Underwear & Socks (x3 pairs): Consider one pair of wool socks for the coldest day.
- [ ] Sleepwear (x1 set)

(Essentials)
- [ ] Passport & Travel Documents
- [ ] Wallet (with GBP/contactless cards)
- [ ] Phone & Charger
- [ ] Laptop/Tablet & Charger
- [ ] UK Power Adapter (Type G)
- [ ] Portable Power Bank
- [ ] Business Cards
- [ ] Notebook & Pen

(Toiletries)
- [ ] Toiletry Bag with travel-sized essentials (toothbrush, toothpaste, deodorant, etc.)
- [ ] Skincare/Moisturizer (wind can be drying)
- [ ] Any personal medications

Packing Tip
Lay out all your items before packing to ensure they coordinate. Roll clothing items to save space and prevent wrinkles in your carry-on. Keep your umbrella and rain jacket easily accessible for your arrival on a rainy day.
